ayahs.1: Main qasam khaata hoon qayamat ke din ki.
ayahs.2: Aur qasam khaata hoon us nafs ki jo malaamat karne wala ho.
ayahs.3: Kya insaan yeh khayaal karta hai ke hum us ki haddiyan jama karenge hi nahin.
ayahs.4: Haan zaroor karenge, hum to qaadir hain ke us ki por por tak durust kar den.
ayahs.5: Balke insaan to chaahta hai ke aage aage nafarmaaniyan karta jaaye.
ayahs.6: Poochhta hai ke qayamat ka din kab aayega.
ayahs.7: Pas jis waqt ke nigaah pathra jaayegi.
ayahs.9: Aur sooraj aur chaand jama kar diye jaaenge.
ayahs.10: Us din insaan kahega ke aaj bhaagne ki jagah kahan hai?
ayahs.12: Aaj to tere Parwardigaar ki taraf hi qaraar-gaah hai.
ayahs.13: Aaj insaan ko us ke aage bheje hue aur peechhe chhode hue se aagaah kiya jaayega.
ayahs.14: Balke insaan khud apne oopar aap hujjat hai.
ayahs.15: Agarche kitne hi bahaane pesh kare.
ayahs.16: (Ae Nabi) aap Quran ko jaldi (yaad karne) ke liye apni zabaan ko harkat na den.
ayahs.17: Us ka jama karna aur (aap ki zabaan se) padhna hamare zimme hai.
ayahs.18: Hum jab use padh len to aap is ke padhne ki pairwi karen.
ayahs.19: Phir is ka waazeh kar dena hamare zimme hai.
ayahs.20: Nahin nahin, tum jaldi milne wali (dunya) ki mohabbat rakhte ho.
ayahs.21: Aur aakhirat ko chhod baithe ho.
ayahs.22: Us roz bahut se chehre taro-taaza aur ba-raunaq honge.
ayahs.23: Apne Rabb ki taraf dekhte honge.
ayahs.24: Aur kitne chehre us din (bad-raunaq aur) udaas honge.
ayahs.25: Samajhte honge ke un ke saath kamar tod dene wala mamla kiya jaayega.
ayahs.26: Nahin nahin, jab rooh hansli tak pahunchegi.
ayahs.27: Aur kaha jaayega ke koi jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai?
ayahs.28: Aur jaan liya us ne ke yeh waqt judaai hai.
ayahs.29: Aur pindli se pindli lipat jaayegi.
ayahs.30: Aaj tere Parwardigaar ki taraf chalna hai.
ayahs.31: Us ne na to tasdeeq ki na namaz ada ki.
ayahs.33: Phir apne ghar walon ke paas itraata hua gaya.
ayahs.34: Afsos hai tujh par, hasrat hai tujh par.
ayahs.35: Waaye hai aur kharabi hai tere liye.
ayahs.36: Kya insaan yeh samajhta hai ke use bekaar chhod diya jaayega.
ayahs.37: Kya woh ek gaadhe paani ka qatra na tha jo tapkaya gaya tha?
ayahs.38: Phir woh lahu ka lothda ho gaya, phir Allah ne use paida kiya aur durust bana diya.
ayahs.39: Phir us se jode, yani nar-o-maada banaye.
ayahs.40: Kya (Allah Taala) is (amr) par qaadir nahin ke murde ko zinda kar de.
